C1220.title: Ctrip Hotel Booking Price-Difference Case Orders Triple Damages and App Agreement Remediation
C1220.summary: In July 2021, the Keqiao District People's Court in Shaoxing found at first instance that Ctrip had engaged in false promotion, price fraud, and deception in Hu's hotel booking. Hu paid 2,889 yuan while the hotel received 1,377.63 yuan. The court ordered Ctrip to pay the remaining 243.37-yuan difference, 4,534.11 yuan in treble damages, and amend relevant app agreement options.
